name: redmo
description: Build live quizzes in RedMo: a host puts them on a big screen and the room plays on their phones.

interface.longDescription:
RedMo is a live quiz platform. A host puts a quiz on a big screen, and everyone in the room joins from their phone with a PIN and plays along.

With this plugin, ChatGPT builds those quizzes for you in your own RedMo account. Describe a topic, paste your notes or a lesson plan, and ChatGPT writes the questions, picks a fitting question type for each one, and saves the quiz. It can attach pictures from a stock photo library, which it shows you first so you choose.

What it can do:
- Create a quiz with multiple choice, true or false, pick the set, type the answer, slider, pin on the picture, put in order and picture answers; polls, scales, word clouds, open-ended questions and brainstorms; and title, bullet point, quote and media slides.
- Read your existing quizzes and change them one slide at a time: edit, insert, move or remove a single slide without touching the rest.
- Publish a draft when you say so.

How it works with you: a new quiz is saved and ready to host. Changes to a quiz that is already published go to a draft, so the version people play stays as it was until you publish. If you are editing the same quiz in the RedMo builder at the same time, a change made from an older copy is refused rather than overwriting your work, and ChatGPT reads the quiz again before retrying.

What it does not do: it does not start or run a live game, see players or results, delete whole quizzes, or reach any account but yours. Hosting happens on redmo.xyz, from the link ChatGPT gives you.

You sign in with your RedMo account and approve access once. You can revoke it at any time in RedMo under Settings.
